lines.show: A cyber-fraud complaint comes in. The money has already moved, through wallets nobody can name.
lines.say: A cyber fraud complaint comes in. The money has already moved, through wallets nobody can name.

lines.show: The investigator has an address, and one question: which exchange do I write to?
lines.say: The investigator has an address, and one question: which exchange do I write to?

lines.show: NOIR answers it. It follows each wallet both ways.
lines.say: Noir answers it. It follows each wallet both ways.

lines.show: Back, to the exchange that funded it. Forward, to the exchange account that received its money.
lines.say: Back, to the exchange that funded it. Forward, to the exchange account that received its money.

lines.show: This is a real wallet, from a recorded read of the TRON chain. MEXC funded one of its payers.
lines.say: This is a real wallet, from a recorded read of the Tron chain. Mex C funded one of its payers.

lines.show: Its money passed through one hop and reached Binance's own wallet.
lines.say: Its money passed through one hop, and reached Bynance's own wallet.

lines.show: And part of it reached an address on the OFAC sanctions list.
lines.say: And part of it reached an address on the O-fack sanctions list.

lines.show: Attribution is a deterministic lookup, not a guess. No language model decides it.
lines.say: Attribution is a deterministic lookup, not a guess. No language model decides it.

lines.show: NOIR can name seventeen exchanges across TRON, Ethereum and Polygon, and screens every wallet against more than a thousand sanctioned addresses.
lines.say: Noir can name seventeen exchanges, across Tron, Ethereum and Polygon, and screens every wallet against more than a thousand sanctioned addresses.

lines.show: Filing is one step. Paste one address, or five hundred, from one case or many.
lines.say: Filing is one step. Paste one address, or five hundred, from one case or many.

lines.show: Each line is checked before a single chain is read.
lines.say: Each line is checked, before a single chain is read.

lines.show: Every wallet lands on one shared desk, under the exchange it leads to.
lines.say: Every wallet lands on one shared desk, under the exchange it leads to.

lines.show: At the top, NOIR names the exchange to write to next, and what needs following up.
lines.say: At the top, Noir names the exchange to write to next, and what needs following up.

lines.show: Wallets that touch a sanctioned address are flagged before any request is sent.
lines.say: Wallets that touch a sanctioned address are flagged, before any request is sent.

lines.show: Below is a departures board: each exchange, the wallets waiting on it, the money that moved, whether it is registered with FIU-IND, and whether its request has gone.
lines.say: Below is a departures board: each exchange, the wallets waiting on it, the money that moved, whether it is registered with F I U India, and whether its request has gone.

lines.show: Open an exchange, and every wallet that leads there is on one page, from every case, in both directions.
lines.say: Open an exchange, and every wallet that leads there is on one page, from every case, in both directions.

lines.show: NOIR records how the exchange receives a law-enforcement request, copied from the exchange's own page.
lines.say: Noir records how the exchange receives a law enforcement request, copied from the exchange's own page.

lines.show: Each wallet states how much evidence was seen, in words. Never a percentage.
lines.say: Each wallet states how much evidence was seen, in words. Never a percentage.

lines.show: Then one click drafts one consolidated request: KYC, access logs, transaction history, preservation, and a freeze where the account is known.
lines.say: Then one click drafts one consolidated request: K Y C, access logs, transaction history, preservation, and a freeze, where the account is known.

lines.show: It prints as a letter. The legal basis is left blank, for the officer to supply.
lines.say: It prints as a letter. The legal basis is left blank, for the officer to supply.

lines.show: NOIR records what each exchange did with it: acknowledged, sent the data, froze the account, refused, or did not answer. And it warns when a reply is late.
lines.say: Noir records what each exchange did with it: acknowledged, sent the data, froze the account, refused, or did not answer. And it warns when a reply is late.

lines.show: Every wallet keeps its own file: the trace, the route, the patterns observed, and a hash of every chain response it was read from.
lines.say: Every wallet keeps its own file: the trace, the route, the patterns observed, and a hash of every chain response it was read from.

lines.show: So an attribution can be checked again, by anyone.
lines.say: So an attribution can be checked again, by anyone.

lines.show: NOIR also says what it cannot do. Its method page lists what is built, what is partial, and what is not.
lines.say: Noir also says what it cannot do. Its method page lists what is built, what is partial, and what is not.

lines.show: An unreadable wallet is never reported as empty. And confidence is how much evidence was seen, never a chance of being right.
lines.say: An unreadable wallet is never reported as empty. And confidence is how much evidence was seen, never a chance of being right.

lines.show: NOIR. Every unknown wallet has a destination.
lines.say: Noir. Every unknown wallet has a destination.
